title: [barefoot] Fan fail to set_speed
author: seanwu-ec
body:
https://github.com/Azure/sonic-buildimage/blob/bf21dbce871a8c87e010af9d193ef27b9635bef8/platform/barefoot/sonic-platform-modules-bfn-montara/sonic_platform/fan_drawer.py#L41

### Suggested change:
Change the line into
`return client.pltfm_mgr.pltfm_mgr_fan_speed_set(self.__num, percent)`

### Reason:
1. NameError: name 'fan' is not defined
2. pltfm_mgr_fan_speed_set() takes fan_num as the first argument. https://github.com/Azure/sonic-buildimage/blob/bf21dbce871a8c87e010af9d193ef27b9635bef8/platform/barefoot/sonic-platform-modules-bfn-montara/sonic_platform/pltfm_mgr_rpc/pltfm_mgr_rpc.py#L309
